tasks.short: Select and order tile and installation items

steps.what: Select tile and other installation items according to specifications and capture order details
Copy selected items, quantities and delivery details into the order draft
Check the order and order tile and other selected installation items

tasks.design: Configure an order draft in {PROCUREMENT} from the setter's checked material selections. Keep selection, compatibility checks and final ordering with the setter; use native order functions before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: Material choices and quantities can be copied again when writing a supplier order.
tasks.enabler_now: Native purchase-order templates can reuse captured selections without choosing the materials.
tasks.still_hard: Match finish, dimensions, batch expectations and installation compatibility to the specification.
tasks.human_edge: Notice an unsuitable substitute and confirm what the installation actually needs.
tasks.altitude: Less repeat entry; material choice and purchasing authority stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Specify exact material variants and delivery constraints.

evidence.claim: Exact for Bouw provides construction purchase-order functions; this supports testing native ordering before custom development.
The proposed repeat-entry saving is an unmeasured model-knowledge scenario and does not remove physical material selection.

assumptions: Boundary starts with approved specifications and previously calculated material quantities and ends with the supplier order. Measuring, takeoff and estimating are separate tasks and their savings are not counted again.

The setter captures supplier, article identifier, manufacturer variant, finish, dimensions, required batch constraints, quantity, unit, price, currency, delivery location and requested date during retained s1 time. Supplier catalogue and quotation information comes from existing supplier publication and quotation work before s1, with no new supplier capture duty.

s2 uses only the selected material order details produced in s1; no free structured selection, stock or compatibility flag is assumed. Missing article codes or unclear variants require manual clarification and ordering without repeat-entry savings.

The setter verifies the complete draft in s3, including quantity units, variant, quotation and address, then approves and sends its exact version. Purchasing limits and any additional existing authorisation remain unchanged; orders outside the setter's authority use the existing approval route.

Test native templates first. Only currently duplicated entry earns saving; already integrated ordering earns none. Incremental focal upkeep is 7 hours per 100 baseline hours for catalogue mismatches and template checks.
unknowns: Whether selections are already captured once in a native ordering system
research_questions: Can native ordering reproduce selected variants and quantities without another manual copy?

already_counted.description: Material selection, field capture, order verification and approval remain.

incremental.description: Resolve catalogue mismatches and check order templates.

approvals.approved_version: Exact order version, supplier, article variants, quantities, units, prices, batch constraints, delivery address and date checked before sending in s3; any change voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=50+0+25=75; gross=25, focal upkeep=7, central net=18. Conservative 3-10 allows manual supplier clarification and incomplete catalogue matching; material selection and order approval receive no reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The setter still selects and orders suitable materials, with less duplicate entry where native ordering can reuse the selection.
reach: Coordinate exact material variants and delivery dates with construction supervisors.
role.ambitious_version: Use any released entry time to resolve material compatibility and delivery questions before placing the order.
